## Context
Organic Gerrit Verify run 31846417650 emitted 260 fixture_setup spans over 1 second totaling 380.393 aggregate worker-seconds. Excluding the separately proven 35-second editor DNS delay, the largest module totals were: tests/unit/test_secret_screen_e7a9.py 28.998s / 23 setups; tests/interfaces/queries/test_list_filters.py 25.856s / 17; tests/integration/test_b636_rebuild_history_loss.py 19.230s / 7; tests/integration/test_prepare_reclaim_backup.py 16.486s / 11; and tests/interfaces/store/test_inline_write_push.py 12.846s / 9. Closed precedent peculiar-calmy-bubblefish proved that a session template plus isolated per-test copies reduced tests/interfaces wall time from 270.7s to 186.5s (31%) while running nine more tests, and explicitly deferred roughly 20 module-local fixtures as the larger remaining win.

## Phase 1 plan
- Trace each measured >1s setup to its exact fixture and separate from-scratch git/rebar store initialization, fixture copying/fix-up, test-body work, and runner variance with setup-only timing plus runtime instrumentation.
- Test the dynamic hypothesis that the five modules repeatedly build equivalent virgin git-backed stores. Confirm only where the same initialized precondition recurs; reject template reuse for fixtures whose setup semantics intentionally vary or whose contract is initialization itself.
- Search ticket history for prior acceptance/rejection and compare the remediation with at least three popular, actively maintained OSS projects using session-scoped expensive templates with isolated per-test copy/reset. Apply the parent ticket consensus rule: at least two-thirds use the practice and none documents rejecting it for coverage/reliability.

## Phase 2 plan (only after confirmed RCA and consensus)
- Add or extend one uniquely named test helper at an existing call-graph seam; use session/worker-local templates and per-test copies only for confirmed equivalent fixtures.
- Preserve the safety contracts established by peculiar-calmy-bubblefish: rewrite both linked-worktree pointers, reject bare git worktree repair, allocate a per-test gate snapshot directory, regenerate environment/signing identity, reset module caches, keep the template virgin, and retain deliberate from-scratch initialization/recovery tests.
- Prove RED->GREEN with durable isolation sentinels before migrating consumers. Do not remove, skip, sample, xfail, or weaken any behavioral assertion.
- Run every affected module, full owning tiers, the full default/integration selectors, lint, typecheck, and workflow guards. Measure paired before/after setup and wall time under the same environment and report runner-seconds saved without claiming critical-path savings from aggregate fixture time.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Every targeted setup is attributed to a specific fixture operation with a focused measured baseline.
- [x] The confirmed RCA includes a runtime experiment that discriminates repeated equivalent store construction from test-body work and unavoidable per-test semantics.
- [x] Tracker history and at least three popular actively maintained OSS projects are cited; consensus is evaluated by the parent rule.
- [x] Only fixtures proven equivalent are migrated; initialization/recovery contracts continue to build from scratch.
- [x] Collected/passed test counts and all pre-existing assertions are preserved or increased.
- [x] Per-test copies cannot share ticket refs, linked-worktree paths, gate snapshots, environment IDs, signing keys, module caches, or mutable config state.
- [x] Durable sentinels fail for stale half-rewritten pointers, bare worktree repair, shared refs, shared identity/signing state, and non-virgin templates.
- [x] A defect-seeded mutation of each newly relied-on isolation fix returns the relevant sentinel to RED.
- [x] Paired before/after setup and module/tier wall-time measurements quantify runner-seconds saved.
- [x] Full affected tiers plus default/integration selectors, lint, typecheck, and workflow guards pass.
- [x] The Gerrit change receives LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 and merges before closure.

## Back-out
Revert the Gerrit change to restore per-test from-scratch fixture construction; no product behavior or coverage destination changes.
